description: Permanently deletes a webhook. A monitor still pointing at it fails to deliver until it is repointed at a different webhook: deletion does NOT cascade-delete or pause the monitors using it. Cannot be undone. Returns 404 `webhook_not_found` if the id does not exist or is not on this account.

id.description: The webhook's id, as returned when the webhook was created or listed.

name: reddit_monitor_webhook_delete
